essence: Isaura, city of a thousand wells, extends exactly as far as its shafts reach a buried lake, so an invisible underground landscape shapes the visible one, and its people split over whether the gods live in the black water below or in every device that lifts it toward the sky.
textDetails: Known as the city of the thousand wells; it is said to stand above a deep subterranean lake.
The city spread wherever digging long vertical holes reached water, and it ends exactly where that stopped working, no farther.
Its green perimeter repeats the dark shoreline of the buried lake: a hidden landscape conditions the visible one.
All motion on the sunlit surface is said to be driven by a wave beating, sealed in, under the limestone (calcareous) vault of rock that is the lake's sky.
Consequently Isaura has two kinds of religion.
One faction holds that the gods dwell in the depths, in the black lake that feeds the underground streams.
The other places the gods in the buckets that rise hanging from a cable as they emerge over the rims of the wells, and in the turning pulleys.
Also in the windlasses of the norias (bucket water wheels) and in the handles of the pumps.
Also in the vanes of the windmills that draw water up from the drill holes, and in the trestles that support the twisting drill probes.
Also in the reservoirs perched on stilts above the roofs and in the slender arches of the aqueducts.
Also in every column of water, the vertical pipes, the plungers and the drains.
And upward as far as the weathercocks that top Isaura's airy scaffoldings.
Isaura is characterised as a city that moves wholly upward.
Not described in the text: houses, streets, inhabitants, the lake's actual shape, or any colour beyond the green border and the black lake; those are design choices here.
visualConcept: A floating island of pale limestone with a wedge cut out of its front, like a slice taken from a cake, so the viewer sees at once the sunlit city on top and, inside the rock, the hollow that sustains it. The two cut faces show horizontal strata in cream and buff and, behind them, a broad low cave whose ceiling, the rock's limestone 'sky', is studded with small stalactites and washed by wavering caustic light; filling the cave floor lies the black lake, near-black (#070d12) and glossy with faint aqua glints, fed by three or four thin luminous streams seeping from the cave walls. On the surface the city fills exactly the lobed outline of the lake below: inside that line the ground is irrigated green and edged by a dense band of hedges and small trees (the green border), outside it the limestone is bare, dry and empty, and at the cut faces the green edge sits plumb above the lake shore, which makes the city's whole premise readable in one glance. The thousand wells are small round stone curbs scattered densely inside the outline, each with a hair-thin shaft dropping through the rock, so the cut faces show a curtain of vertical threads, a root system binding city to lake, while under the intact part of the city the shafts open in the cave ceiling and drip into the water. Among low whitewashed houses rises the entire upward apparatus the text names: windlasses with buckets on cables, pulleys, norias ringed with pots and turned by capstans, hand pumps, many-bladed windpumps on lattice towers, timber drilling trestles with twisting augers, cylindrical reservoirs on stilts over the roofs, slender aqueduct arcades, vertical pipes and, highest of all, a few airy timber scaffold towers crowned by weathercocks. Apart from the shafts, every silhouette climbs, so the island reads as a city drawn upward by a lake it cannot see.
layout: Island: limestone slab of radius about 22 with an eroded rim, top surface at y=0, rough tapering underside to about y=-16. Cutaway: a wedge of about 100 degrees removed from the front (centred on the default camera azimuth) from y=0 down to the base, exposing two vertical section faces. Shared outline: one closed lobed curve, for example r(theta) = 14 + 3.2 sin(2 theta + 0.7) + 1.8 sin(3 theta + 2.1) + 0.9 sin(7 theta + 0.3), giving about 9 to 19 units, used both for the lake shore and for the green border. Cave: the outline plus 1.5 units, ceiling vault from y=-2.5 at the centre to y=-5 at the edges, lake surface at y=-7, lake bed at y=-8.5. Surface: green border as a 1.2-wide band of hedges and round trees along the curve, lighter garden green inside, bare limestone with scattered stones outside. Wells: exactly 1000 curbs (radius 0.12-0.18, height 0.15) by Poisson-disc sampling inside the curve, slightly denser toward the border; each with a shaft (radius 0.03) from y=0 to the cave ceiling. Houses: about 300 whitewashed flat-roofed blocks (footprint 0.8-1.5, height 0.5-1.3) clustered between the wells. Devices: 150 windlass frames with rope and bucket over wells; 60 hand pumps; 8 norias (wheel radius 0.9-1.3 with 16-20 pots, each driven by a capstan with a long sweep arm); 14 windpumps (lattice towers 2.5-4 tall, 18-blade rotors of radius 0.6-0.9, tail vanes); 5 drilling trestles (timber pyramids 3-5 tall with a helical auger in the middle); 36 rooftop reservoirs (cylinders radius 0.35, height 0.5, on four legs 0.8-1.2 tall); 3 aqueduct arcades (arch span 0.9, height 1.3-2, lengths 8-14) converging on a central cistern; thin vertical pipes running up towers and reservoir legs; 5 airy scaffold towers (open timber lattice 6-10 tall, the tallest near the centre), each topped by a weathercock. People: about 120 figures 0.25 tall at wellheads, pumps and capstans.
signatureMotion: 1) The hidden wave drives the visible city: a broad swell crosses the black lake every 9 seconds; as its crest passes beneath a well, a bright aqua pulse climbs that shaft (about 3 units per second, visible as moving light in the cut faces) and on arrival the device above responds: the bucket jerks upward, a pump handle dips, a small spray of droplets lifts from the curb and fades, so from above a ripple of activity sweeps across the city in exact step with the unseen swell. 2) Perpetual upward motion: windpump rotors spin and gust, norias turn slowly, buckets climb their cables, light runs up the vertical pipes, and weathercocks swing on the highest scaffolds; the dominant direction of every movement is up. 3) In the cave: drops fall from the shaft mouths and ring the black water with concentric ripples, and soft caustic light trembles across the limestone ceiling.
interactionDescription: Toggles between Isaura's two religions. Default, the gods above: the rock is opaque, the lake lies black, and the machinery takes the light, with buckets, pulleys, vanes, reservoirs and weathercocks gleaming and a fine column of droplets rising from the wells into the sky. Toggled, the gods below: the rock turns into a smoky translucent shell, the camera eases down to cave level, the city above dims to silhouette, and the black lake glows softly from within, its outline brightening and all thousand shafts lit as threads descending toward it. The swell-driven pulses continue in both states, the one fact both faiths share.
mood: Late morning in a dry upland: hard white sun, crisp short shadows, a clear blue sky fading to a chalky limestone haze at the horizon, and a wet glint wherever water breaks the surface. Beneath the rock it is perpetual night: cool and hushed, lit only by thin blades of daylight falling down the shafts and a faint aqua phosphorescence on the black water. Devotional and quietly mechanical, a hum of pulleys over a silence of deep water.
caption: Isaura spreads only as far as its wells can reach, so its green edge is a portrait of a lake no one has seen. Under the limestone, black water stirs in the dark; overhead, a thousand ropes, wheels and vanes answer it, lifting, turning, climbing. Half the city prays to the depths, half to the bucket breaking into sunlight, and both are praying to the same water at different heights.
motto: The hidden lake draws the city, as one draws water.
camera: Three-quarter view into the wedge cut: camera about 50 units from the island centre, elevation about 16 degrees, azimuth on the wedge's bisector, target (0, -3, 0), so the sunlit city fills the upper half of the frame and the cave with the black lake the lower half; FOV about 35. Auto-orbit limited to about +/-40 degrees so the cut faces always stay in view.
